hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.notebook_path // empty'); b=$(git -C "$(dirname "${f:-.}")" branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); { [ "$b" = "main" ] || [ "$b" = "master" ]; } && jq -nc --arg b "$b" --arg msg 'You are editing a file on the default branch. This project lands work through pull requests, and main auto-deploys to Render. Stop and ask the user whether to create a branch before continuing.' '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",additionalContext:$msg},systemMessage:("Editing on \($b) - consider branching first.")}'; exit 0
